case_summary.review_route_explanation: No policy establishes an attendance-proxy admission decision or a specific review route for AI proxy attendance.
case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Verification and admission of the disclosed proxy, and a valid basis for fulfilling any compulsory student participation.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Murdoch policies contain no provisions for verifying or admitting a disclosed AI avatar as a lecture proxy or determining whether such attendance satisfies compulsory participation requirements.
case_summary.case_note: Exhaustive searches of Murdoch's policy corpus found no provision governing a disclosed AI avatar attending online lectures or fulfilling compulsory participation on a student's behalf. General rules in Student Integrity Regulations (N164) and IT Conditions of Use (N077) do not establish proxy verification, admission authority, or participation validity, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
